query: What does HTTP status code 404 mean?
report:
## Meaning of 404

A 404 response means the server could not find the requested resource [1]. RFC 9110 defines 404 as the Not Found status code [2]. Many sites return 404 for pages that were deleted [3].

## References

[1] MDN Web Docs. 404 Not Found. Retrieved from https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Status/404
[2] RFC 9110. HTTP Semantics. Retrieved from https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html
[3] Example parking page. Retrieved from https://example.com/gone

sources.title: 404 Not Found
sources.content: The HTTP 404 Not Found response status code indicates that the server cannot find the requested resource. Links that lead to a 404 page are often called broken or dead links.

sources.title: HTTP Semantics
sources.content: RFC 9110 defines the 404 status code as Not Found. The server did not find a current representation for the target resource.
